description.value: Coastal Black Estate Winery is a four-generation family farm and award-winning estate fruit winery, cidery, and meadery located in Black Creek at the base of Mt. Washington in the Comox Valley. The farm produces fruit wines, sparkling wines, meads, ciders, raw honey, and seasonal farm products, all available for tasting and purchase at an on-site tasting room. The property also hosts seasonal events including a Tulip Festival, Sunflower Fest, and Pumpkin Fest, making it a notable rural destination on a Vancouver Island cycling route.

address.value: 2186 Endall Rd, Black Creek, BC V9J 1G8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active (references 2026 Tulip Fest and © 2026), confirming the business is open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website; products are clearly sold in-person at the farm stand and tasting room, supporting a Takeout value of true.
